title: AgentFoundryTaskPlan
description: Task plan generated by Agent Foundry Planner Layer. Strictly enforces ROLE != PLATFORM and forbids executor/platform bindings.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier corresponding to the Task Capsule

planner_provider.description: LLM capability provider used for planning (e.g. antigravity)

summary.description: Brief textual summary of the decomposed plan

created_at.description: Timestamp when the plan was generated

goal.description: Specific sub-goal to achieve in this step

role.description: Task role assigned for this step. Must NOT be an executor/platform name.

description.description: Optional detailed instructions for this step

depends_on.description: Optional list of prior step indices that must be completed before this step

isolation.description: Optional workspace isolation mode for this step

parallel_group.description: Optional identifier for parallel execution grouping
